caption:
Everything you hold tonight will one day end

Allah tells us that whatever we have will come to an end, but whatever is with Him will last forever, and that He will reward those who remain steadfast according to the best of their deeds. Hold the world lightly, and hold on to what lasts.

Surah An-Nahl 16:96

Save this for the moment the world feels too heavy to hold

#dunya #akhirah #steadfast #quranreels

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
